posts.title: Portfolio Update: MetricFauna Website
posts.description: Sharing a Wordpress website I developed for the African animal welfare non-profit, MetricFauna. By creating a custom child-theme, it could be customized for the brand including custom icons, graphics, and careful selection of stock photography by African photographers as much as possible.

posts.title: Why I don't use generative AI
posts.description: Why I don't use generative AI as a graphic designer or web designer, with twelve different reasons why. I don't use generative AI for any writing, design, code, or for information or research. I also share an artwork of Astro Boy I made punching genAI company logos and destroying a data center.
